conversationalSummary.text: Tomorrow is probably one to skip. Baleal at Evening — 19:00 looks like the least-bad option, but not really something worth chasing. The wind looks like the main issue and could easily make it messy. I'd check Surfline or MEO Beachcam first, but unless it looks surprisingly clean, I'd save the drive.

best.explanation: Baleal looks like a fun-sized window for Safe fun, Low confidence: 0.6-1.1 m, 164 kJ, 8 s period, consistent 77/100, and wind is the main risk.  A broad, forgiving beach setup with several peaks; this is best for spreading out and finding a manageable wave when the bay has enough push.  Watch: wind angle is poor for this spot; 6-9s at mid tide is soft and sectiony on the Baleal sandbanks.
best.shortExplanation: Baleal is worth a quick check for evening — 19:00, but it is not a guaranteed session.  Treat it as a check-first call rather than a sure thing.  Wind is the main thing to watch.  The tide is part of the picture, but not the deciding factor.
